quote.text: Having problems is not nearly as tormenting as being had by problems.
quote.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Embrace that challenges in raising children will always surface; it is the manner in which you respond—not the inherent difficulty—that shapes the family’s growth.
    • Just as a wise guardian seeks to understand rather than be overrun by trials, let each parenting problem guide you to deeper patience and reflective understanding.
  • Leadership:
    • As a leader, treat challenges as opportunities to demonstrate resilience; confronting issues head-on empowers both yourself and your team.
    • Remember that being dominated by problems can stifle vision; instead, harness each obstacle as a lesson in control and measured response.
  • Product Management:
    • In the realm of product management, obstacles are a natural part of the process—manage them with strategy rather than allowing them to dictate your course.
    • Transform each setback into an occasion for innovation, ensuring that problems serve as stepping stones rather than barriers to progress.
